score_notes.christology: Affirms Jesus as 'the eternal Son of God,' conceived of the Holy Spirit, born of the virgin Mary, 'fully God, fully man.' Substitutionary atonement, bodily resurrection, ascension, and return. Orthodox Christology.
score_notes.scripture: Strong inerrancy affirmation: Bible has 'truth, without any mixture of error, for its matter' and 'all Scripture is totally true and trustworthy.' Scripture is 'the supreme standard by which all human conduct, creeds, and religious opinions should be tried.' Green — clear inerrancy position.
score_notes.gender: GREEN — Complementarian. All-male elder board (7 elders). Lead Teaching Pastor Benjamin Bolin (male). All pastoral/minister titles held by men. Women serve as 'Minister to Preschool and Children' (Pam Reigle) and in director/coordinator roles. Beliefs statement affirms: 'A husband is to love his wife as Christ loved the church. He has the God-given responsibility to provide for, to protect, and to lead his family. A wife is to submit herself graciously to the servant leadership of her husband.' Clear complementarian theology.
score_notes.leadership: Elder-led governance with 7 male elders who 'serve to shepherd and to give oversight' (1 Peter 5:2-3). Lead Teaching Pastor Benjamin Bolin. Senior Associate Pastor Donnie Voss. Multiple ministers for specific areas. Strong accountability structure.
score_notes.soteriology: Comprehensive salvation doctrine: regeneration, justification, sanctification, glorification. 'There is no salvation apart from personal faith in Jesus Christ as Lord.' Sound Reformed Baptist soteriology.
score_notes.cultural: No explicit DEI/CRT language detected. Spanish-language ministry (Travis en Espanol). Community outreach ministries. Historic church. Needs in-person verification but no red flags from website.
score_notes.preaching: Title 'Lead Teaching Pastor' suggests teaching emphasis. Multiple worship styles (choir-led, band-led, Spanish). Unable to verify expository vs. topical from website alone. The strong doctrinal statement suggests substantive preaching.
score_notes.mission: Mission: 'helping people far from God know Christ through global, domestic, and local impact.' Global Mission Coordinator on staff. Community ministries. College ministry. Spanish-language outreach. Great Commission-oriented.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: No dedicated men's ministry found despite having women's ministry programs (CELC & WOW). Small groups and Sunday School exist but no men-specific discipleship. Yellow — gap for a church this size.
score_notes.denominational: SBC-affiliated per SBC Churches Directory. Strong doctrinal alignment with Baptist Faith & Message. Elder-led governance. Green for denominational accountability.
